title: Finite-type subideal module diagram and its colimit
statement: Let X be a qcqs scheme [def-pc-scheme] and I a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf [def-nagata-extended-ideal, pqf-def-coherent]. Index by A = {K | K ≤ I and K.ofFiniteType}, ordered by inclusion. There exist a diagram D : A → Mod(O_X), a cocone τ with point I.toModules, and a proof that this cocone is a colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For every a in A, a.val.toModules is of finite type and there is an isomorphism e : D(a) → a.val.toModules whose inverse followed by τ(a) and I.toModulesι is a.val.toModulesι. The stage identifications and monomorphic structure-sheaf inclusions specify the diagram and cocone up to the canonical isomorphism used downstream. No cohomology assertion is included.

source.place: Properties, Tag 01PG, applied to ideal sheaves; first sentence of Tag 01XG

proof.text: Construct D on the subtype of finite-type subideals, with objects K.toModules and maps IdealSheafData.toModulesOfLE. Cancel the monomorphic inclusions into the structure sheaf to prove identity, composition, and cocone naturality. The cocone legs are toModulesOfLE of K ≤ I, and the stage isomorphisms are identities. Reuse the proved inclusion construction from WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Curve.DivisorIdealSheaf.

The index family is nonempty because it contains the zero ideal. Apply directedOn_ofFiniteType_le and sSup_ofFiniteType_le_eq, then nonempty_isColimit_of_directed_ideal_modules with the identity stage isomorphisms and the inclusion compatibility. This produces the required IsColimit.
Apply isFiniteType_toModules to the finite-type proof in each subtype member. Combine this with the identity stage isomorphism and the inclusion equation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteType_ideal_module_diagram (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (_hI : I.toModules.IsQuasicoherent) :
    ∃ (D : {K : X.IdealSheafData // K ≤ I ∧ K.ofFiniteType} ⥤ X.Modules)
      (τ : D ⟶ (Functor.const _).obj I.toModules)
      (_ : IsColimit (Cocone.mk I.toModules τ)),
      ∀ a, a.val.toModules.IsFiniteType ∧
        ∃ e : D.obj a ≅ a.val.toModules,
          e.inv ≫ τ.app a ≫ I.toModulesι = a.val.toModulesι
